title: The Guggenheim Sold This Kandinsky for $62,000. Tomorrow It Could Sell for $80 Million.
yt_title: Kandinsky's Betonte Ecken at Christie's: $62K to $80M

slides.text: The *Guggenheim* had more Kandinskys than room. It sold 50. *Betonte Ecken* went for *£22,000*, about *$62,000*.

slides.label: Nov 17
slides.text: It leads *Christie's* 20th Century Evening Sale at *$60 to $80 million*.

slides.label: Record
slides.text: A guarantor has already committed above Kandinsky's record of *$44.55 million*. The record *will fall*.

slides.label: The week
slides.text: About *$1.7 billion* of art is expected to sell in New York's November auctions.

slides.label: Go see it
slides.text: Christie's *Rockefeller Center* galleries are open to the public, *free*, through *Nov 17*.

question: What would you pay $80 million for? Wrong answers only.
